comparison.objective: Join a shelf to a cabinet side using two cam locks.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient eccentric cams, align and insert a panel onto bolts/dowels, then turn both cams with screwdrivers.
comparison.success_condition: Both bolt heads captured, cams locked, joint gap closed, tools returned and hands clear; closed-cam obstruction prevents success.
comparison.reason: Bimanual panel assembly and rotary locking do not test screening, media flow, or selective retention.
